correctness.rationale: PASS: the cap min(rank(X−Y),3) is a true translation-invariant metric on all m×n F_q matrices, 4≤m≤n, since min of an integer subadditive rank by 3 preserves subadditivity. The rank-one convolution gives k_s=(q^(m+n−s)−q^n−q^m+1)/(q−1); counting ordered two-rank-one sums gives c1=q^m+q^n−q−2 and c2=q(q+1), yielding rank-two multiplier h_s=(k_s²−c1 k_s−v1)/c2. The capped power multiplier is Λ_s=(1−3^p)k_s+(2^p−3^p)h_s−3^p. Algebraic comparison of monotone k_s and R_p=(3^p−1)/(3^p−2^p)<3 shows the unique dominant nontrivial dual rank s=m−1 for every p>0. The submitted B>2A+3 exact polynomial lower bound gives a unique positive root β<1 of Φ=A−B2^p+(B−A−1)3^p; the other sectors remain strictly below. Endpoint multiplicity counts rank-(m−1) characters and the centered Gram rank gives both Euclidean dimensions. Independently tested Fourier sector maxima at p<β, p=β, p>β for (q,m,n)=(2,4,4),(2,4,5),(3,4,4),(4,4,5),(2,6,7). Full pinned verify.py and exact walk-count reasoning reviewed; checks do not replace all-q,m,n proof.
